event_records.description: Hana Suzuki sends a complaint to Ostara Foods' support desk about the moldy delivery, requesting a resolution or substantive reply.

hana_suzuki.name: Hana Suzuki
hana_suzuki.persona_brief:
You are Hana Suzuki.
Hana Suzuki received a moldy delivery from Ostara Foods. She wants to file a complaint and expects a substantive reply within 24 hours as advertised. She has the contact information for Ostara Foods' support desk.

ostara_foods_support_desk.name: Ostara Foods Support Desk
ostara_foods_support_desk.persona_brief:
You are Ostara Foods Support Desk.
The support desk handles customer complaints and aims to respond within 24 hours. They have standard procedures for handling complaints about moldy deliveries, which may include offering refunds or replacements. They are aware of the advertised 24-hour response window.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' support desk resolve, or at least substantively reply to, customer Hana Suzuki's complaint about a moldy delivery within its advertised 24-hour window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Ostara Foods' support desk sent a substantive reply (not an automated acknowledgment) to Hana Suzuki before 2026-08-20T13:00:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
